reviews.title: Packaging quality could be improved
reviews.text: This listing was not the cheapest eutectoid-stage hardening retort we considered, and that was fine. Packaging on this listing was poor enough that we checked it over carefully on arrival, finding two minor dents out of 153 litres of chamber space. It has not changed what we think of this listing overall.
